functions.name: IsSafeToDestroy
functions.docs: Returns true if it's safe to destroy this queue.

functions.name: Enqueue
functions.docs: Put a blob to be sent in the queue. Returns true if the blob was successfully queued and false if the queue was full.

functions.name: Peek
functions.docs: On the receiving end this will return a pointer to the next blob that can be processed.

functions.name: Pop
functions.docs: On the receiving end this will remove the next blob to be processed from the queue. Call after processing the blob returned from Peek().

functions.name: DequeueUnreliable
functions.docs: On the receiving end this will move all received unreliable NetBlobs to the array and release them from the queue. This breaks the ordering guarantees provided by using Peek and Pop. Reliable NetBlobs are unaffected by this operation.

functions.name: DropUnreliable
functions.docs: On sending side this will drop all unreliable in the queue to avoid creating a backlog of unsent unreliable blobs
